scope.flow: RiskEngine.twapEMA destructures the tuple returned by OraclePack.getEMAs() and returns a blended TWAP tick
evidence: `RiskEngine.twapEMA` destructures the tuple returned by `oraclePack.getEMAs()` in the wrong order. `getEMAs()` returns `(spotEMA, fastEMA, slowEMA, eonsEMA, medianTick)`, but `twapEMA` binds the first three values as `(eonsEMA, slowEMA, fastEMA, , )`. This swaps the EMA components and drops the real eons EMA, producing an incorrect time-weighted price signal.
